long_biography.plain_text:
At Plexus Worldwide, American entrepreneur Tarl Robinson favoured a limited product range so the business could concentrate on fewer lines. He directed a shift towards gut-health products in 2014, while developing combinations of supplements intended to be used together. He wanted these combinations to encourage longer customer relationships and invested in training for the distributors who sold them.

His approach to international expansion required support for local distributors before entering a new country. Within the company, a weekly focus group and an ambassador advisory board gave those sellers a voice in decisions. Plexus also upgraded its social-media integration, product checkout and administrative software.
